# `instr`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

```text
instr(str, substr)
```

Returns the (1-based) index of the first occurrence of `substr` in `str`.

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `string_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 1.5.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | 2 |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
SELECT instr('SparkSQL', 'SQL');
```

Result:

```text
6
```
